title: cam6_cosp_calipso_diag: COSP/CALIPSO/CloudSat and cloud-top diagnostics for CESM2/CAM6
description: Output-only diagnostic patches for CESM 2.1.5 / CAM6 (CAM tag cam_cesm2_1_rel_60): COSP on every physics time step, CALIPSO and CloudSat cloud-top fields, MG2 cloud-top fields and an in-model cloud-top diagnostics module. The patches also correct the swapped CLD_CAL_TMPLIQ and CLD_CAL_TMPICE fields of stock CAM. They were used for the cloud-top phase evaluation of Villanueva et al. (in review).

creators.name: Villanueva, Diego
